53600.meaning1: according to inclination; as per one's wish
53600.meaning2: according to inclination; as per wish

examples.text: tena avasari tadavasari. tatrā'pi yath'ājjhāsayaṃ viharitvā vesāliṃ agamāsi.

53601.meaning1: however it is standing; just as it is positioned
53601.meaning2: as it was, just as he stood

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ yathāṭhitaṃ yathāpaṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati atthi imasmiṃ kāye pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū'ti

53602.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathātaccha
53602.meaning1: truthfully; according to the truth; how it really is; in reality

examples.text: sutvān'ahaṃ vīram'akāmakāmiṃ, ogh'ātigaṃ puṭṭhum'akāmam'āgamaṃ, santipadaṃ brūhi sahajanetta, yathātacchaṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

53604.meaning1: as it truly is; according to the truth; accurately
53604.commentary: (ITIa) sabbaloke yathātathan'ti tasmiṃ tedhātukalokasannivāse yaṃkiñci neyyaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ yathātathaṃ aviparītaṃ jānitvā.

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā, sabbasaṅkhārasamathā, saññānaṃ uparodhanā, evaṃ dukkhakkhayo hoti, etaṃ ñatvā yathātathaṃ.
aññātam'etaṃ vacanaṃ, asitassa yathātathaṃ, taṃ taṃ gotama pucchāmi, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ.

53605.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of yathātatha
53605.meaning1: as it truly is; according to the truth; accurately
53605.commentary: (THa) diṭṭhe dhamme yathātathe'ti catusaccadhamme pariññā-pahāna-sacchikiriya-bhāvanā-vasena maggapaññāya yathābhūtaṃ diṭṭhe.

examples.text: khīṇāya bhavanettiyā, diṭṭhe dhamme yathātathe, na bhayaṃ maraṇe hoti, bhāranikkhepane yathā.
na hi etehi yānehi, gaccheyya agataṃ disaṃ, yath'āttanā sudantena, danto dantena gacchati.

53607.commentary: (VINt) yathādāne'y'eva upanetabban'ti yathā dāyakena dinnaṃ, tathā upanetabbaṃ, akālacīvarapakkhe'y'eva ṭhapetabban'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

53608.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathādiṭṭha
53608.meaning1: according to what one has seen; as observed

examples.text: tassa so yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ byākaroti, evaṃ kho, āvuso, saṅkhārā daṭṭhabbā, evaṃ saṅkhārā sammasitabbā, evaṃ saṅkhārā vipassitabbā'ti.

53609.meaning1: in line with one's view; according to one's belief
53609.commentary: (ANa) yathādiṭṭhī'ti yā yā diṭṭhi, tassā tassā anurūpaṃ.

examples.text: micchādiṭṭhikassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa yañ'c'eva kāyakammaṃ yathādiṭṭhi samattaṃ samādinnaṃ yañ'ca vacīkammaṃ … yañ'ca manokammaṃ yathādiṭṭhi samattaṃ samādinnaṃ yā ca cetanā yā ca patthanā yo ca paṇidhi ye ca saṅkhārā sabbe te dhammā aniṭṭhāya akantāya amanāpāya ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.

53610.meaning1: in line with one's view; according to one's belief
53610.commentary: (ANa) yathādiṭṭhissa ca padhānan'ti heṭṭhimamaggasampayuttaṃ vīriyaṃ. tañ'hi tassā diṭṭhiyā anurūpattā yathādiṭṭhissa ca padhānan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: katame dve? diṭṭhivisuddhi ca yathādiṭṭhissa ca padhānaṃ. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā.

53611.meaning1: according to the rule; in accordance with the case
53611.commentary: (VINa) yathādhammo kāretabbo'ti aññāṇena āpannattā tassā āpattiyā mokkho n'atthi, yathā pana dhammo ca vinayo ca ṭhito, tathā kāretabbo.

examples.text: na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi, yañ'ca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno, tañ'ca yathādhammo kāretabbo, uttari c'assa moho āropetabbo

53612.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathādhamma
53612.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.3) yathādhammaṃ nāma dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena kataṃ, etaṃ yathādhammaṃ nāma. (VINa) yathādhamman'ti yo yassa adhikaraṇassa vūpasamanāya dhammo vutto, ten'eva dhammenā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ yathādhammaṃ nihat'ādhikaraṇaṃ punakammāya ukkoṭeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
accayaṃ accayato na passati, accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ nappaṭikaroti, parassa kho pana accayaṃ desentassa yathādhammaṃ nappaṭiggaṇhāti

53613.meaning1: going according to plan; in line with expectations

examples.text: ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekaccassa tādisā'va vaṇijjā payuttā na yath'ādhippāyā hoti? ko nu kho, bhante hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekaccassa tādisā'va vaṇijjā payuttā yath'ādhippāyā hoti?

atha kho bhagavā yathādhotena pattena pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi tathādhotena pattena paṭikkami. atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, api tvaṃ, samaṇa, piṇḍam'alatthā'ti?

53616.meaning1: of such name; so called; called whatever
53616.commentary: (VINa) yathānāmo'ti nāmavasena yathānāmo vā tathānāmo vā hotu, buddharakkhito vā dhammarakkhito vā saṅgharakkhito vā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo panā'ti yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. eso vuccati, yo panā'ti.
so aparena samayena chātakabhaye sampatte yathānikkhittaṃ dhaññaṃ paribhuñjanto koṭṭhesu ca cāṭiādīsu ca nikkhittadhaññe parikkhīṇe parijane pakkosāpetvā āha.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, uparipabbate thullaphusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūreti.

53619.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathānucchavika
53619.meaning2: according to suitability; as is appropriate

53620.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathānubhāva
53620.meaning1: according to one's ability; according to one's power

examples.text: atha antena jahati, sarīraṃ sapariggahaṃ, etadaññāya medhāvī, bhuñjetha ca dadetha ca, datvā ca bhutvā ca yath'ānubhāvaṃ, anindito saggam'upeti ṭhānan'ti.

53621.meaning1: sequence of a sutta arising from a natural connection
53621.meaning2: sequence of meaning in a sutta dictated by the natural course of the Dhamma
53621.commentary: (BVa) yena pana dhammena ādimhi desanā uṭṭhitā, tassa dhammassa anurūpadhammavasena vā paṭikkhepavasena vā yesu suttesu uparidesanā āgacchati, tesaṃ vasena yath'ānusandhi veditabbā.

examples.text: tena vuttaṃ yath'ānusandhivasena desanā āgatā'ti. brahmavihāresu pana anupadavaṇṇanā ca bhāvanānayo ca sabbo sabb'ākārena visuddhimagge vutto.

53623.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathānusiṭṭha
53623.meaning1: as advised; as instructed; as taught
53623.commentary: (DNa) yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno'ti yathā mayā anusiṭṭhaṃ anusāsanī dinnā, tathā paṭipajjamāno.

examples.text: yath'ānusiṭṭhaṃ tathāpaṭipajjamāno, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissati sattavassāni.

53624.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāpaccaya
53624.meaning1: as one likes; as you wish; as you prefer

examples.text: tena vattabbo, ko te mitto vā sandiṭṭho vā'ti? itthan'nāmo ca itthan'nāmo cā'ti. tena vattabbo, ahaṃ tesaṃ dammi, tesaṃ santakaṃ paribhuñja vā vissajjehi vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karohī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yaṃ imasmiṃ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya

53625.meaning1: as decreed; as prescribed; as formulated
53625.meaning2: as decreed; as prescribed; as formulated

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū apaññattaṃ na paññāpessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattissanti

53626.meaning1: practising accordingly; practicing in line with

examples.text: oḷārikassa'pi kho ahaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attapaṭilābhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi, yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodāniyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti
brahmānañ'c'āhaṃ, māṇava, pajānāmi brahmalokañ'ca brahmalokagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ, yathāpaṭipanno ca brahmalokaṃ upapanno tañ'ca pajānāmī'ti.

53627.meaning1: prepared in such a way; as prepared

53628.meaning1: however it is positioned; however it is disposed

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ yathāṭhitaṃ yathāpaṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati atthi imasmiṃ kāye pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū'ti

53629.meaning1: as one has learned it; according to one's understanding

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti.
no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ, moggallāna, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkeyyāsi anuvicāreyyāsi manasā anupekkheyyāsi

53630.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāparisā
53630.meaning1: as far as the audience extends; (comm) as far as the limit of the solar system

examples.text: yathāparisaṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sarena viññāpeti, na c'assa bahiddhā parisāya ghoso niccharati.

53631.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāpasādana
53631.meaning1: according to what inspires one; according to what one has confidence in

examples.text: dadāti ve yathāsaddhaṃ, yathāpasādanaṃ jano, tattha yo maṅku bhavati, paresaṃ pānabhojane, na so divā vā rattiṃ vā, samādhim'adhigacchati.
yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.
tena kho pana, bhikkhu, samayena tādiso'v'assa kiṃsuko yathā'pi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ.

53636.commentary: (DNa) tasmā rañño vacan'ānantaraṃ agamā kho tvaṃ, mahārāja, yathāpeman'ti āha. tass'attho, mahārāja, yathā nāma unname vuṭṭhaṃ udakaṃ yena ninnaṃ tena gacchati, evam'eva tvaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā yena pemaṃ tena gato'ti.

examples.text: agamā kho tvaṃ, mahārāja, yathāpeman'ti. piyo me, bhante, udayabhaddo kumāro.

53638.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathābala
53638.meaning1: according to one's power; according to one's means; according to one's level
53638.commentary: (SNa) ten'āhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmī'ti tass'āhaṃ attano satti-anurūpena c'eva bal'ānurūpena ca saṃvibhāgaṃ karomi.

examples.text: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye sīlavante pabbajite kulaṃ upasaṅkamante manussā yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajanti

53639.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathābala
53639.commentary: (DNa) yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānenā'ti daharehi kātabbaṃ mahallakehi, mahallakehi vā kātabbaṃ daharehi, itthīhi kātabbaṃ purisehi, purisehi vā kātabbaṃ itthīhi akāretvā tassa tassa bal'ānurūpen'eva kamm'antasaṃvidhānena.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi ayyirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, yathābalaṃ kamm'antasaṃvidhānena bhattavetan'ānuppadānena gilān'upaṭṭhānena acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena samaye vossaggena.

atha kho tā devatāyo pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhahitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, accayo no, bhante, accagamā yathābālā yathāmūḷhā yathāakusalā, yā mayaṃ bhagavantaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimhā.

53641.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathābāla

examples.text: taggha taṃ, bhikkhu, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo tvaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhi
accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.
saccaṃ, bhante, bhāsitā me esā vācā, yathābālena yathāmūḷhena yathā-akusalenā'ti.

53643.commentary: (DNa) yathābhatena bhaṇḍenā'ti yaṃ vo tiṇakaṭṭh'odaka-bhaṇḍakaṃ āropitaṃ, tena yathābhatena yath'āropitena, yathāgahitenā'ti attho. (DNt) yathābhatenā'ti sakaṭesu yathāṭhapitena, yathā amma ito karohī'ti vutte ṭhapesī'ti attho karaṇakiriyāya kiriyāsāmaññavācībhāvato. tasmā yath'āropitena, yathāgahitenā'ti attho vutto.

examples.text: na no purāṇaṃ chaḍḍessāmā'ti. evaṃ, bho'ti kho te satthikā tassa satthavāhassa paṭissutvā yathābhatena bhaṇḍena satthaṃ payāpesuṃ. te paṭhame'pi satthavāse na addasaṃsu tiṇaṃ vā kaṭṭhaṃ vā udakaṃ vā.
taṃ vācaṃ appahāya, taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yath'ābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.

53647.meaning1: taken pleasure in like that; thus indulged in

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, ānanda, ekaṃ rūpam'pi samanupassāmi yattha rattassa yath'ābhiratassa rūpassa vipariṇām'aññathābhāvā na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'ūpāyāsā.

53648.grammar: ind, adv, comp, accsg of yathābhiranta
53648.meaning1: as long as one likes; as much as one pleases; as long as one wants

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhoganagare yath'ābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pāvā ten'upasaṅkamissāmā'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yath'ābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.

53650.synonym: ekanta, cheka, taccha, tatha, bhūta, saccika

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, aññ'eva dhammā gambhīrā duddasā duranubodhā santā paṇītā atakk'āvacarā nipuṇā paṇḍitavedanīyā, ye tathāgato sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti, yehi tathāgatassa yathābhuccaṃ vaṇṇaṃ sammā vadamānā vadeyyuṃ.
aṭṭha yathābhuccavaṇṇā

53652.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathābhutta

examples.text: rājā mahāsudassano evam'āha, pāṇo na hantabbo, adinnaṃ na ādātabbaṃ, kāmesu micchā na caritabbā, musā na bhaṇitabbā, majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ, yathābhuttañ'ca bhuñjathā'ti.

53653.meaning1: as it is; in reality; of such nature

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ kāyo yathābhūtasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassā'pi kamanti, leḍḍusamphassā'pi kamanti, daṇḍasamphassā'pi kamanti, satthasamphassā'pi kamanti.
sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ

53654.meaning1: knowledge of things exactly as they are; understanding of reality

examples.text: etadānuttariyaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇānaṃ yadidaṃ tattha yathābhūtañāṇaṃ. etasmā c'āhaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇā aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā n'atthī'ti vadāmi.

53655.meaning1: knowing and seeing reality; understanding and insight into things as they really are
53655.commentary: (SNa) yathābhūtañāṇadassanan'ti yathāsabhāvajānanasaṅkhātaṃ dassanaṃ. etena taruṇavipassanaṃ dasseti. taruṇavipassanā hi balavavipassanāya paccayo hoti.

examples.text: nibbidam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ. kā ca, bhikkhave, nibbidāya upanisā? yathābhūtañāṇadassanan'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ.

53656.meaning1: for the purpose of understanding and insight into things as they really are

examples.text: samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassan'attho yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, sukhaṃ samādh'atthaṃ samādh'ānisaṃsaṃ, passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā

53657.meaning1: who has successfully achieved knowing and seeing reality; with understanding and insight into things as they really are

examples.text: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-sampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo

53658.meaning1: who has failed in knowing and seeing reality; devoid of understanding and insight into things as they really are

examples.text: dussīlassa, bhikkhave, sīlavipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-vipannassa hat'ūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo, nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hat'ūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.

53659.meaning1: for the benefit of understanding and insight into things as they really are

examples.text: samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassan'attho yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, sukhaṃ samādh'atthaṃ samādh'ānisaṃsaṃ, passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā

53660.meaning1: with understanding and insight into things as they really are as precondition

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

53661.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathābhūta
53661.meaning1: as it truly is; in reality
53661.meaning2: in truth, in reality, in its real essence

examples.text: samaṇo, āvuso, gotamo sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti, etha tumhe, bhikkhave, pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvethā'ti.
tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatth'assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti

53662.meaning1: according to the fact of friendship
53662.commentary: (VINa) yathāmittatā'ti yathāmittatāya, yo yo mitto, tassa tassa detī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. esa nayo sabbapadesu.

examples.text: yathāsanthutaṃ nāma yathāmittatā yathāsandiṭṭhatā yathāsambhattatā yathāsamān'upajjhāyakatā yathāsamān'ācariyakatā.
vosāsantī nāma yathāmittatā yathāsandiṭṭhatā yathāsambhattatā yathāsamān'upajjhāyakatā yathāsamān'ācariyakatā, idha sūpaṃ detha, idha odanaṃ dethā'ti. esā vosāsantī nāma.
evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā samantā vesāliyā yathāmittaṃ yathāsandiṭṭhaṃ yathāsambhattaṃ vassaṃ upagacchuṃ.

atha kho tā devatāyo pathaviyaṃ patiṭṭhahitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, accayo no, bhante, accagamā yathābālā yathāmūḷhā yathāakusalā, yā mayaṃ bhagavantaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimhā.

53665.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāmūḷha
53665.meaning1: so misguidedly; so stupidly; so foolishly

examples.text: accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.
taggha taṃ, bhikkhu, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo tvaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhi

53666.meaning1: so deludedly; so confusedly; so incoherently

examples.text: saccaṃ kira, nigrodha, bhāsitā te esā vācā'ti? saccaṃ, bhante, bhāsitā me esā vācā, yathābālena yathāmūḷhena yathā-akusalenā'ti.
sādhu, bhante, bhagavā aññaṃ pariyāyaṃ ācikkhatu yath'āyaṃ bhikkhusaṅgho aññāya saṇṭhaheyyā'ti.

yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

53668.meaning1: of such activity; engaged in such work
53668.commentary: (VINa) yathāyutto'ti yogavasena yena vā tena vā yutto hotu, navakammayutto vā uddesayutto vā vāsadhurayutto vā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo panā'ti yo yādiso yathāyutto yathājacco yathānāmo yathāgotto yathāsīlo yathāvihārī yathāgocaro thero vā navo vā majjhimo vā. eso vuccati, yo panā'ti.

53669.commentary: (VINa) na sakkā hoti yathāyuttena sakaṭenā'ti dvīhi balibaddehi yuttena sakaṭena ekaṃ cakkaṃ nibbodakapatanaṭṭhāne ekaṃ bahi katvā āvijjituṃ na sakkā hoti.

examples.text: aparikkamanaṃ nāma na sakkā hoti yathāyuttena sakaṭena anuparigantuṃ samantā nisseṇiyā anuparigantuṃ. etaṃ aparikkamanaṃ nāma.

53672.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāraha
53672.meaning1: as is suitable; as is appropriate
53672.commentary: (ANa) yathārahan'ti tesu tesu dhammesu yath'ānucchavikaṃ samān'attatā'ti attho.

examples.text: dānañ'ca peyyavajjañ'ca, atthacariyā ca yā idha, samān'attatā ca dhammesu, tattha yath'ārahaṃ, ete kho saṅgahā loke, rathass'āṇī'va yāyato.

53673.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāraha

53674.meaning2: according to one's pleasure; according to preference

53675.meaning1: according to preference; at one's pleasure; as one likes

53676.meaning1: of such form; such kind of; of such value

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, yathārūpe adinn'ādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā
maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati. yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati.

53677.meaning1: each one's own; according to personal

examples.text: atha kho, bhante, devā tāvatiṃsā yathāsakesu āsanesu nisīdiṃsu, obhāsam'etaṃ ñassāma, yaṃvipāko bhavissati, sacchikatvāva naṃ gamissāmā'ti.
gaṇikā kumbhadāsī ca, pūvikā macchikā'pi ca, yathāsakena thāmena, pūgadhammaṃ akaṃsu te.

53678.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāsaka
53678.meaning1: according to one's own; each one's own

examples.text: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, byākataṃ kho, āvuso, amhehi sabbeh'eva yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.
evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ revataṃ etadavoca, byākataṃ kho, āvuso revata, āyasmatā ānandena yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.

53679.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāsaṅkhyā

examples.text: māna kita'icc'etesaṃ dhātūnaṃ abbhāsagatānaṃ vakāra takārattaṃ hoti vā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ. vīmaṃsati, tikicchati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? cikicchati.
tato abbhāsato pā māna'icc'etesaṃ dhātūnaṃ vā maṃ'icc'ete ādesā honti yathāsaṅkhyaṃ sapaccaye pare. pivāsati, vīmaṃsati.

53680.meaning1: percipient of whatever; with whatever perception

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, moggallāna, yathāsaññissa te viharato taṃ middhaṃ okkamati taṃ saññaṃ mā manas'ākāsi taṃ saññaṃ mā bahulam'akāsi

53681.commentary: (SNa) ten'āhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmī'ti tass'āhaṃ attano satti-anurūpena c'eva bal'ānurūpena ca saṃvibhāgaṃ karomi.

examples.text: yo imāhi catūhi disāhi āgamissati samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā, tam'ahaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ paṭipūjessāmī'ti.
tattha yo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vāsaṃ upeti, ten'āhaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ saṃvibhajāmi.

53683.meaning1: according to what one has confidence in; according to faith

examples.text: dadāti ve yathāsaddhaṃ, yathāpasādanaṃ jano, tattha yo maṅku bhavati, paresaṃ pānabhojane, na so divā vā rattiṃ vā, samādhim'adhigacchati.

53684.meaning1: ascetic who sleeps on any bed; ascetic who accepts any dwelling
53684.commentary: (THa) sen'āsanaloluppaṃ paṭikkhipitvā yathāsanthatik'aṅgasamādānena yathāsanthatiko. (NIDD1a) yathāsanthatik'aṅgan'ti yadeva santhataṃ yathāsanthataṃ, idaṃ tuyhaṃ pāpuṇātī'ti evaṃ paṭhamaṃ uddiṭṭhasen'āsanass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmiṃ yathāsanthate viharituṃ sīlam'assā'ti yathāsanthatiko, tassa aṅgaṃ yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ. (VISM) tasmiṃ yathāsanthate viharituṃ sīlam'assā'ti yathāsanthatiko. tassa aṅgaṃ yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi yathāsanthatiko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na yathāsanthatikā'ti. so tena yathāsanthatikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

aṭṭha dhut'aṅgāni, āraññik'aṅgaṃ, piṇḍapātik'aṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ, tecīvarik'aṅgaṃ, sapadānacārik'aṅgaṃ, khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ, nesajjik'aṅgaṃ, yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ, idaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ.

53685.meaning2: practice of being satisfied with whatever dwelling

examples.text: aṭṭha dhut'aṅgāni, āraññik'aṅgaṃ, piṇḍapātik'aṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ, tecīvarik'aṅgaṃ, sapadānacārik'aṅgaṃ, khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ, nesajjik'aṅgaṃ, yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ, idaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ.

53686.meaning1: fact of being an ascetic who sleeps on any bed
53686.construction:
yathā + santhata + ika + tta
yathāsanthatika + tta

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi yathāsanthatiko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na yathāsanthatikā'ti. so tena yathāsanthatikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
so paṭipadaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ karitvā tena yathāsanthatikattena n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, sappurisadhammo.
